title: joint-quiescent-corner
description: The joint-quiescent corner of a commutative nuclear square: A* = Fix(σ) ∩ Fix(Δ). The doubly quiescent layer where both nuclei have nothing left to apply. Corresponds to the absurd phase of articulation (both token-axis and claim-axis articulated). Holds the aperiodic-autopoiesis-cell.
